newsitem.title: USA: PerSeptive to appeal patent ruling.
newsitem.headline: PerSeptive to appeal patent ruling.

text.p: Biotechnology company PerSeptive Biosystems Inc said Friday it will appeal a court ruling involving patents for a specialized method of separating and purifying molcules in the biotechnology industry.
"This case is far from over," it said, adding that it will appeal the pre-trial rulings to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit.

On Thursday, the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts ruled against PerSeptive in a patent infringement dispute, saying it failed to show that it did not intentionally fail to credit all those involved in its patents for the method.
PerSeptive is suing Pharmacia Biotech, Sepracor Inc and its subsidiary BioSepra Inc for allegedly infringing on its Perfusion Chromatography patents.
